query: Could you identify all wireless gaming devices with exceptional Wireless Performance Efficiency above 8.5? I'd like to see the device registry ID and the calculated WPE value (rounded to 2 decimal places) for each device, sorted by highest WPE first.
sol_sql: WITH wpr_cte AS ( SELECT d.devregistry, ( d.wlrangem / 10.0 ) * ( 1 - d.wllatvar / 5.0 ) * ( 1 + ( CASE WHEN d.wlchanhop THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) / 2.0 ) * ( ( t.wlsignal + 100 ) / 100.0 ) AS wpr, d.wllatvar FROM deviceidentity AS d JOIN testsessions AS t ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry ), ber_cte AS ( SELECT d.devregistry, ( t.battlifeh * t.battcapmah ) / ( d.pwractmw * 10.0 ) AS ber FROM deviceidentity AS d JOIN testsessions AS t ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry WHERE d.pwractmw > 0 ) SELECT wpr.devregistry, ROUND(wpr.wpr * SQRT(ber.ber / 5.0) * ( 1 - wpr.wllatvar / 3.0 ) * 2, 2) AS wpe FROM wpr_cte AS wpr JOIN ber_cte AS ber ON wpr.devregistry = ber.devregistry WHERE wpr.wpr * SQRT(ber.ber / 5.0) * ( 1 - wpr.wllatvar / 3.0 ) * 2 > 8.5 ORDER BY wpe DESC NULLS FIRST

query: Show me all gaming devices with Physical Endurance Rating above 9.0. I need their registry IDs, Durability Score, dust resistance length, water resistance length, bend force, and calculated PER value (rounded to 2 decimal places), sorted from highest to lowest PER.
sol_sql: WITH ds_cte AS ( SELECT physregistry, ( ( drophtm / 2.0 ) + ( bendforce / 100.0 ) + ( twistdeg / 90.0 ) ) * ( usbconndur / 10000.0 ) * 10 AS ds, dustres, waterres, bendforce FROM physicaldurability ) SELECT ds.physregistry, ROUND(ds.ds, 2) AS ds, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ds.dustres, '') = 'IPX0' THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE(ds.dustres, '') = 'IPX1' THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE(ds.dustres, '') = 'IPX2' THEN 2 WHEN COALESCE(ds.dustres, '') = 'IPX3' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS dustres_score, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ds.waterres, '') = 'IPX0' THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE(ds.waterres, '') = 'IPX1' THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE(ds.waterres, '') = 'IPX2' THEN 2 WHEN COALESCE(ds.waterres, '') = 'IPX3' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS waterres_score, ds.bendforce, ROUND( ds.ds * ( 1 + ( CASE WHEN COALESCE(ds.dustres, '') = 'IPX0' THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE(ds.dustres, '') = 'IPX1' THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE(ds.dustres, '') = 'IPX2' THEN 2 WHEN COALESCE(ds.dustres, '') = 'IPX3' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN COALESCE(ds.waterres, '') = 'IPX0' THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE(ds.waterres, '') = 'IPX1' THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE(ds.waterres, '') = 'IPX2' THEN 2 WHEN COALESCE(ds.waterres, '') = 'IPX3' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END ) / 6.0 ) * ( 1 - ( 100 - ds.bendforce ) / 200.0 ), 2 ) AS per FROM ds_cte AS ds WHERE ds.ds * ( 1 + ( CASE WHEN COALESCE(ds.dustres, '') = 'IPX0' THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE(ds.dustres, '') = 'IPX1' THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE(ds.dustres, '') = 'IPX2' THEN 2 WHEN COALESCE(ds.dustres, '') = 'IPX3' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN COALESCE(ds.waterres, '') = 'IPX0' THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE(ds.waterres, '') = 'IPX1' THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE(ds.waterres, '') = 'IPX2' THEN 2 WHEN COALESCE(ds.waterres, '') = 'IPX3' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END ) / 6.0 ) * ( 1 - ( 100 - ds.bendforce ) / 200.0 ) > 9.0 ORDER BY per DESC NULLS FIRST

query: I need a report of gaming devices with high Professional Adoption Rating. Show me the device registry ID, Competitive Gaming Performance Index, profile count, Sensor Performance Index, Input Responsiveness Score, and calculated PAR value for all devices with PAR exceeding 8.5. All calculated values should be rounded to 2 decimal places. Sort the results by PAR in descending order.
sol_sql: WITH spi_cte AS ( SELECT devregistry, ( dpires / 1000.0 ) * ( 1 - mcresptime / 10.0 ) * 10 AS spi FROM deviceidentity ), irs_cte AS ( SELECT d.devregistry, ( t.pollratehz / 100.0 ) * ( 1 - ( t.inplagms + t.resptimems ) / 30.0 ) * 10 AS irs FROM deviceidentity AS d JOIN testsessions AS t ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry ), spr_cte AS ( SELECT m.mechdevref, ( LOG(10, m.swtchdur) / 7.0 ) * m.swtchcons * ( 1 - m.keychatter / 2.0 ) AS spr FROM mechanical AS m ), rai_cte AS ( SELECT i.interactdevref, ( ( i.joyprec + i.dpadacc ) / 20.0 ) * ( 1 - t.inplagms / 10.0 ) * 10 AS rai FROM interactionandcontrol AS i JOIN deviceidentity AS d ON i.interactdevref = d.devregistry JOIN testsessions AS t ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry ), cgpi_cte AS ( SELECT d.devregistry, ( irs.irs * 0.4 ) + ( spi.spi * 0.3 ) + ( spr.spr * 0.2 ) + ( rai.rai * 0.1 ) AS cgpi, d.profcount FROM deviceidentity AS d JOIN spi_cte AS spi ON d.devregistry = spi.devregistry JOIN irs_cte AS irs ON d.devregistry = irs.devregistry JOIN spr_cte AS spr ON d.devregistry = spr.mechdevref JOIN rai_cte AS rai ON d.devregistry = rai.interactdevref ) SELECT c.devregistry, ROUND(c.cgpi, 2) AS cgpi, c.profcount, ROUND(spi.spi, 2) AS spi, ROUND(irs.irs, 2) AS irs, ROUND( ( c.cgpi / 10.0 ) * ( 1 + c.profcount / 5.0 ) * ( ( spi.spi + irs.irs ) / 15.0 ), 2 ) AS par FROM cgpi_cte AS c JOIN spi_cte AS spi ON c.devregistry = spi.devregistry JOIN irs_cte AS irs ON c.devregistry = irs.devregistry WHERE ( c.cgpi / 10.0 ) * ( 1 + c.profcount / 5.0 ) * ( ( spi.spi + irs.irs ) / 15.0 ) > 8.5 ORDER BY par DESC NULLS FIRST

query: Which gaming keyboards and mice have high Input Responsiveness Score ratings? Please show me the device ID, manufacturer, model number, polling rate, input lag, response time, and calculated IRS (rounded to 2 decimal places) for all keyboards and mice that score above 8.0. Sort the results from highest to lowest IRS.

query: Create a materialized view called 'premium_gaming_mice' that identifies Premium Gaming Mouse. The view should include the device registry, manufacturer name, model number, calculated SPI score, calculated CI score, and a classification field that labels each mouse as either 'Premium Gaming Mouse' that can meet the Premium Gaming Mouse standard or 'Standard Mouse' for others. Only include devices categorized as mice.
sol_sql: CREATE VIEW premium_gaming_mice AS SELECT d.devregistry, d.makername, d.modnum, (CAST(d.dpires AS REAL) / 1000) * (1 - d.mcresptime / 10) * 10 AS spi, (CAST(m.ergorate AS REAL) / 10) * (1 + (CASE WHEN m.wristflag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 5) * (1 - ABS(m.palmangle - 15) / 45) * 10 AS ci, CASE WHEN (CAST(d.dpires AS REAL) / 1000) * (1 - d.mcresptime / 10) * 10 > 7.5 AND d.dpires >= 16000 AND ts.pollratehz >= 1000 THEN 'Premium Gaming Mouse' ELSE 'Standard Mouse' END AS classification FROM deviceidentity d JOIN mechanical m ON d.devregistry = m.mechdevref JOIN testsessions ts ON d.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry WHERE ts.devscope = 'Mouse';
test_cases:
def test_case(pred_sqls, sol_sqls, db_name, conn):
    from decimal import Decimal
    check_view_sql = "SELECT * FROM premium_gaming_mice"
    view_result = execute_queries([check_view_sql], db_name, conn)[0]
    assert len(view_result) > 0, "View should return at least one row of data"
    assert len(view_result[0]) == 6, "View should return 6 columns (devregistry, makername, modnum, spi, ci, classification)"
    for row in view_result:
        spi_value = Decimal(str(row[3]))
        dpires = execute_queries([f"SELECT dpires FROM deviceidentity WHERE devregistry = '{row[0]}'"], db_name, conn)[0][0][0]
        mcresptime = execute_queries([f"SELECT mcresptime FROM deviceidentity WHERE devregistry = '{row[0]}'"], db_name, conn)[0][0][0]
        expected_spi = Decimal(str(dpires)) / Decimal('1000') * (Decimal('1') - Decimal(str(mcresptime)) / Decimal('10')) * Decimal('10')
        assert abs(spi_value - expected_spi) < Decimal('0.01'), f"SPI calculation incorrect for device {row[0]}"
        pollratehz = execute_queries([f"SELECT ts.pollratehz FROM deviceidentity d JOIN testsessions ts ON d.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry WHERE d.devregistry = '{row[0]}'"], db_name, conn)[0][0][0]
        if spi_value > Decimal('7.5') and Decimal(str(dpires)) >= Decimal('16000') and Decimal(str(pollratehz)) >= Decimal('1000'):
            assert row[5] == 'Premium Gaming Mouse', f"Device {row[0]} should be classified as 'Premium Gaming Mouse'"
        else:
            assert row[5] == 'Standard Mouse', f"Device {row[0]} should be classified as 'Standard Mouse'"
    device_check_sql = """
    SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM premium_gaming_mice pgm
    JOIN deviceidentity d ON pgm.devregistry = d.devregistry
    JOIN testsessions ts ON d.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
    WHERE ts.devscope != 'Mouse'
    """
    non_mouse_count = execute_queries([device_check_sql], db_name, conn)[0][0][0]
    assert non_mouse_count == 0, "View should only contain mouse devices"
    return 1

query: Create a reference table called 'battery_efficiency_enum' to store the battery efficiency classification values ('Excellent Efficiency', 'Good Efficiency', 'Average Efficiency', 'Poor Efficiency'), then populate it with these four classification levels. Next, create a view named 'classify_battery_efficiency' that implements the Battery Efficiency Classification system for wireless gaming devices. The view should return device ID, calculated BER (Battery Efficiency Ratio) value, and efficiency classification by joining deviceidentity and testsessions tables. Only include devices with wireless or Bluetooth connection types, and apply the standard BER classification thresholds (>7.5 for Excellent, 5.0-7.5 for Good, 2.5-4.9 for Average, else Poor).
sol_sql: CREATE TABLE battery_efficiency_enum (class VARCHAR(30) PRIMARY KEY);
INSERT INTO battery_efficiency_enum (class) VALUES ('Excellent Efficiency');
INSERT INTO battery_efficiency_enum (class) VALUES ('Good Efficiency');
INSERT INTO battery_efficiency_enum (class) VALUES ('Average Efficiency');
INSERT INTO battery_efficiency_enum (class) VALUES ('Poor Efficiency');

CREATE VIEW classify_battery_efficiency AS SELECT d.devregistry AS device_id, (ts.battlifeh * ts.battcapmah) / (d.pwractmw * 10) AS ber, CASE WHEN (ts.battlifeh * ts.battcapmah) / (d.pwractmw * 10) > 7.5 THEN 'Excellent Efficiency' WHEN (ts.battlifeh * ts.battcapmah) / (d.pwractmw * 10) BETWEEN 5.0 AND 7.5 THEN 'Good Efficiency' WHEN (ts.battlifeh * ts.battcapmah) / (d.pwractmw * 10) BETWEEN 2.5 AND 4.9 THEN 'Average Efficiency' ELSE 'Poor Efficiency' END AS class FROM deviceidentity d JOIN testsessions ts ON d.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry WHERE d.conntype LIKE '%Wireless%' OR d.conntype = 'Bluetooth'
test_cases:
def test_case(pred_sqls, sol_sqls, db_name, conn):
    from decimal import Decimal
    test_function_sql = "SELECT * FROM classify_battery_efficiency"
    function_result = execute_queries([test_function_sql], db_name, conn)[0]
    assert len(function_result) > 0, "Function should return at least one row of data"
    assert len(function_result[0]) == 3, "Function should return 3 columns (device_id, ber, class)"
    for row in function_result:
        device_id = row[0]
        ber_value = Decimal(str(row[1]))
        efficiency_class = row[2]
        battlifeh = execute_queries([f"SELECT battlifeh FROM testsessions ts JOIN deviceidentity d ON ts.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref WHERE d.devregistry = '{device_id}'"], db_name, conn)[0][0][0]
        battcapmah = execute_queries([f"SELECT battcapmah FROM testsessions ts JOIN deviceidentity d ON ts.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref WHERE d.devregistry = '{device_id}'"], db_name, conn)[0][0][0]
        pwractmw = execute_queries([f"SELECT pwractmw FROM deviceidentity WHERE devregistry = '{device_id}'"], db_name, conn)[0][0][0]
        expected_ber = Decimal(str(battlifeh)) * Decimal(str(battcapmah)) / (Decimal(str(pwractmw)) * Decimal('10'))
        assert abs(ber_value - expected_ber) < Decimal('0.01'), f"BER calculation incorrect for device {device_id}"
        if expected_ber > Decimal('7.5'):
            assert efficiency_class == 'Excellent Efficiency', f"Device {device_id} should be classified as 'Excellent Efficiency'"
        elif Decimal('5.0') <= expected_ber <= Decimal('7.5'):
            assert efficiency_class == 'Good Efficiency', f"Device {device_id} should be classified as 'Good Efficiency'"
        elif Decimal('2.5') <= expected_ber <= Decimal('4.9'):
            assert efficiency_class == 'Average Efficiency', f"Device {device_id} should be classified as 'Average Efficiency'"
        else:
            assert efficiency_class == 'Poor Efficiency', f"Device {device_id} should be classified as 'Poor Efficiency'"
    device_check_sql = """
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM classify_battery_efficiency cbe
    JOIN deviceidentity d ON cbe.device_id = d.devregistry
    WHERE d.conntype NOT LIKE '%Wireless%' AND d.conntype != 'Bluetooth'
    """
    non_wireless_count = execute_queries([device_check_sql], db_name, conn)[0][0][0]
    assert non_wireless_count == 0, "Function should only include wireless or Bluetooth devices"
    return 1

query: Delete all audio devices from the audioandmedia table that are identified as Subpar Audio Devices. After deletion, return the audio device registry ID, sound level in decibels, and total harmonic distortion percentage of the deleted devices.
preprocess_sql: CREATE TABLE audioandmedia_bak AS SELECT * FROM audioandmedia;
sol_sql: WITH audio_quality_metrics AS ( SELECT a.audregistry, a.freqresp, a.thdpct, a.noiseisodb, (1 - a.thdpct/2.0) * (a.spksensedb/100.0) * (1 - a.audlatms/100.0) * 10 AS aqi, CASE WHEN instr(a.freqresp, 'Hz') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(a.freqresp, 1, instr(a.freqresp,'Hz')-1) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS hz_val, CASE WHEN instr(a.freqresp, 'kHz') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(a.freqresp, 1, instr(a.freqresp,'kHz')-1) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS khz_val FROM audioandmedia a ), substandard_devices AS ( SELECT audregistry FROM audio_quality_metrics WHERE aqi <= 8.0 OR thdpct >= 0.5 OR noiseisodb <= 15 OR hz_val IS NULL OR hz_val > 10 OR khz_val IS NULL OR khz_val < 22 ) DELETE FROM audioandmedia WHERE audregistry IN (SELECT audregistry FROM substandard_devices) RETURNING audregistry, sndleveldb, thdpct;
test_cases:
def test_case(pred_sqls, sol_sqls, db_name, conn):
    from decimal import Decimal
    delete_result = pred_query_result
    assert len(delete_result) > 0, "The deletion should affect at least one row"
    assert len(delete_result[0]) == 3, "The RETURNING clause should return 3 columns (audregistry, sndleveldb, thdpct)"
    for row in delete_result:
        from decimal import Decimal
        assert isinstance(row[0], str), "First column (audregistry) should be a string"
        assert isinstance(row[1], (float, int, Decimal, type(None))), "Second column (sndleveldb) should be a number or NULL"
        assert isinstance(row[2], (float, int, Decimal, type(None))), "Third column (thdpct) should be a number or NULL"
    remaining_substandard_sql = """
    WITH audio_quality_metrics AS (
        SELECT a.audregistry, a.freqresp, a.thdpct, a.noiseisodb,
               (1 - a.thdpct/2.0) * (a.spksensedb/100.0) * (1 - a.audlatms/100.0) * 10 AS aqi,
               CASE WHEN instr(a.freqresp, 'Hz') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(a.freqresp, 1, instr(a.freqresp,'Hz')-1) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS hz_val,
               CASE WHEN instr(a.freqresp, 'kHz') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(a.freqresp, 1, instr(a.freqresp,'kHz')-1) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS khz_val
        FROM audioandmedia a
    )
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM audio_quality_metrics aqm
    WHERE aqm.aqi <= 8.0 
       OR aqm.thdpct >= 0.5
       OR aqm.noiseisodb <= 15
       OR aqm.hz_val IS NULL
       OR aqm.hz_val > 10
       OR aqm.khz_val IS NULL
       OR aqm.khz_val < 22
    """
    remaining_count = execute_queries([remaining_substandard_sql], db_name, conn)[0][0][0]
    assert remaining_count == 0, "No substandard devices should remain after deletion"
    return 1

query: Can you generate a list of trader IDs for all traders who meet the criteria for our High-Risk Trader Profile? From that group, please only include those who have also faced a Significant Enforcement Action where the related compliance case was last reviewed within the past 12 months. Just provide the unique trader registration IDs.
sol_sql: WITH RelevantTraders AS ( SELECT t.tradereg, t.voldaily / NULLIF(t.acctbal, 0) AS dtr, CAST(json_extract(t.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.levratio') AS REAL) AS tle, json_extract(t.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.risklevel') AS risk_level_text FROM trader t ), HighRiskProfile AS ( SELECT tradereg FROM RelevantTraders WHERE (tle > 5.0 AND risk_level_text = 'Aggressive') OR dtr > 0.5 ), RecentSignificantEnforcements AS ( SELECT DISTINCT tr.trdref AS tradereg FROM enforcementactions ea JOIN compliancecase cc ON ea.compref2 = cc.compreg JOIN transactionrecord tr ON cc.transref = tr.transreg WHERE (ea.penimp IN ('Fine', 'Ban') OR ea.acttake = 'Suspension' OR ea.busrestr = 'Full') AND cc.lastrevdt >= date((SELECT MAX(lastrevdt) FROM compliancecase), '-12 months') ) SELECT DISTINCT hrp.tradereg FROM HighRiskProfile hrp INNER JOIN RecentSignificantEnforcements rse ON hrp.tradereg = rse.tradereg LIMIT 100;

query: I need to compare the average Aggressive Suspicion Score between transactions where layering is 'Confirmed' and those where it is 'Suspected'. Please calculate the average ASS for each of these two groups. Display the layering status ('Confirmed' or 'Suspected') and the corresponding average ASS, rounded to three decimal places.
sol_sql: WITH TransactionBaseMetrics AS ( SELECT tr.transreg, tr.risk_indicators, ( t.voldaily / NULLIF(t.acctbal, 0) ) AS dtr, CAST(( t.trading_performance -> '$.risklevel' ->> '$.levratio' ) AS REAL) AS tle, ( tr.modfreq / NULLIF(1 - tr.cancelpct, 0) ) AS omi FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg WHERE tr.cancelpct < 1 ), CalculatedScores AS ( SELECT tbm.transreg, tbm.risk_indicators ->> '$.layerind' AS layer_indicator, ( tbm.dtr * tbm.tle * tbm.omi ) AS ati, ( ( 0.3 * CAST(( tbm.risk_indicators ->> '$.spoofprob' ) AS REAL) / 100.0 ) + ( 0.2 * CAST(( tbm.risk_indicators ->> '$.frontscore' ) AS REAL) / 100.0 ) + ( 0.1 * CAST(( tbm.risk_indicators ->> '$.qstuffindex' ) AS REAL) ) + ( 0.2 * CASE tbm.risk_indicators ->> '$.washsus' WHEN 'High' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.1 END ) + ( 0.2 * CASE tbm.risk_indicators ->> '$.layerind' WHEN 'Confirmed' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END ) ) AS sai FROM TransactionBaseMetrics AS tbm ), ASS_Calculation AS ( SELECT cs.transreg, cs.layer_indicator, ( cs.sai * cs.ati ) AS ass FROM CalculatedScores AS cs WHERE cs.layer_indicator IN ('Confirmed', 'Suspected') ) SELECT layer_indicator, ROUND(AVG(ass), 3) AS average_ass FROM ASS_Calculation GROUP BY layer_indicator

query: Please identify transaction records that trigger a Potential Insider Trading Flag. For these specific flagged transactions, calculate their Sentiment-Driven Leakage Risk score, and for these High SDLR Transactions, please show the transaction register ID, the trader reference ID, the transaction timestamp, the original information leakage score, and the calculated SDLR score rounded to 2 decimal places.
sol_sql: WITH TransactionSentiment AS ( SELECT tr.transreg, tr.trdref, tr.transtime, sf.* FROM transactionrecord AS tr INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS sf ON tr.transreg = sf.transref ), InsiderFlaggedTransactions AS ( SELECT transreg, trdref, transtime, infoleaksc, optvolrt, newsscore, socscore FROM TransactionSentiment WHERE infoleaksc > 50.0 AND NOT corpeventprx IS NULL AND eventannotm IN ('Pre-market', 'Intraday') ), CalculatedRisks AS ( SELECT ift.*, ABS(ift.newsscore - ift.socscore) AS sdf, ift.optvolrt * ( 1 + ABS(ift.newsscore - ift.socscore) ) AS swov FROM InsiderFlaggedTransactions AS ift ), SDLR_Calculation AS ( SELECT cr.*, ROUND(cr.swov * cr.infoleaksc, 2) AS sdlr FROM CalculatedRisks AS cr ) SELECT transreg, trdref, transtime, infoleaksc, sdlr FROM SDLR_Calculation WHERE sdlr > 1000 LIMIT 100

query: I need an analysis comparing different types of traders. For each trader type, please calculate the average Aggressive Trading Intensity and the average Compliance Health Score. Display the trader type, the calculated average ATI, and the average CHS, rounding the averages to two decimal places. Finally, sort the results by the average ATI in descending order.
sol_sql: WITH TraderMetrics AS ( SELECT t.tradereg, t.tradekind, t.acctdays, t.voldaily / NULLIF(t.acctbal, 0) AS dtr, CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(json_extract(t.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.levratio'), '[', ''), ']', '') AS REAL) AS tle FROM trader t ), TransactionAvgMetrics AS ( SELECT trdref, AVG(modfreq / NULLIF(1 - cancelpct, 0)) AS avg_omi FROM transactionrecord WHERE cancelpct < 1 GROUP BY trdref ), ComplianceMetrics AS ( SELECT tr.trdref, AVG(cc.prevviol / CAST(MAX(1, tm.acctdays / 365.0) AS REAL)) AS avg_crs, AVG(CASE cc.comprate WHEN 'A' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 2 WHEN 'C' THEN 3 WHEN 'D' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END) AS avg_comprate_value FROM compliancecase cc JOIN transactionrecord tr ON cc.transref = tr.transreg JOIN TraderMetrics tm ON tr.trdref = tm.tradereg GROUP BY tr.trdref ), CombinedScores AS ( SELECT tm.tradereg, tm.tradekind, (tm.dtr * tm.tle * COALESCE(tam.avg_omi, 0)) AS ati, 1.0 / (1.0 + COALESCE(cm.avg_crs, 0) * COALESCE(cm.avg_comprate_value, 1)) AS chs FROM TraderMetrics tm LEFT JOIN TransactionAvgMetrics tam ON tm.tradereg = tam.trdref LEFT JOIN ComplianceMetrics cm ON tm.tradereg = cm.trdref ) SELECT tradekind, ROUND(AVG(ati), 2) AS average_ati, ROUND(AVG(chs), 2) AS average_chs FROM CombinedScores GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY average_ati DESC LIMIT 100

query: Please identify all compliance cases associated with traders flagged for Networked Mimicry Risk. For each of these specific cases, calculate the Investigation Intensity Index (III), rounding it to two decimal places. List the compliance case registration ID and its corresponding Investigation Intensity Index (III). Finally, sort the results by the Investigation Intensity Index in descending order and show only the top 100 cases.
sol_sql: WITH PeerMimicryTraders AS ( SELECT DISTINCT tr.trdref AS tradereg FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg WHERE ABS(ab.patsim - ab.peercorr) < 0.1 AND ab.peercorr > 0.7 ), CollusionNetworkCases AS ( SELECT cc.compreg, cc.transref FROM investigationdetails AS idet JOIN compliancecase AS cc ON idet.compref = cc.compreg WHERE idet.tcirclesz > 5 AND idet.grpbehsc > 0.6 AND idet.commpat = 'Regular' ), NetworkMimicryRiskCases AS ( SELECT DISTINCT cnc.compreg FROM CollusionNetworkCases AS cnc JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON cnc.transref = tr.transreg JOIN PeerMimicryTraders AS pmt ON tr.trdref = pmt.tradereg ), InvestigationScores AS ( SELECT nmrc.compreg, ROUND(( 0.6 * idet.behansc ) + ( 0.4 * idet.netansc ), 2) AS iii FROM NetworkMimicryRiskCases AS nmrc JOIN investigationdetails AS idet ON nmrc.compreg = idet.compref ) SELECT compreg, iii FROM InvestigationScores ORDER BY iii DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

query: First, identify all traders who qualify as High-Risk Manipulator Candidates. Then, for this specific group of traders, calculate the average Unique Pattern Deviation Ratio based on their transaction history. Please provide only this single average value, rounded to two decimal places.
sol_sql: WITH TraderBaseMetrics AS ( SELECT t.tradereg, t.voldaily / IIF(t.acctbal = 0, NULL, t.acctbal) AS dtr, CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(json_extract(t.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.levratio'), '[', ''), ']', '') AS REAL) AS tle, json_extract(t.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.risklevel') AS risk_level_text FROM trader t ), HighRiskTraders AS ( SELECT tradereg FROM TraderBaseMetrics WHERE tle > 5.0 AND risk_level_text = 'Aggressive' OR dtr > 0.5 ), ManipulationPatternTraders AS ( SELECT DISTINCT tr.trdref AS tradereg FROM transactionrecord tr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT transreg, modfreq / IIF(1 - cancelpct = 0, NULL, 1 - cancelpct) AS omi FROM transactionrecord WHERE cancelpct < 1 ) AS omi_calc ON tr.transreg = omi_calc.transreg WHERE json_extract(tr.risk_indicators, '$.layerind') = 'Confirmed' OR ( CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(json_extract(tr.risk_indicators, '$.spoofprob'), '[', ''), ']', '') AS REAL) > 0.75 AND IFNULL(omi_calc.omi, 0) > 1.0 ) ), HighRiskManipulators AS ( SELECT hrt.tradereg FROM HighRiskTraders hrt INTERSECT SELECT mpt.tradereg FROM ManipulationPatternTraders mpt ), AdvancedBehaviorMetrics AS ( SELECT tr.trdref AS tradereg, AVG(ABS(ab.patsim - ab.peercorr)) AS avg_pas, AVG(ab.patsim) AS avg_patsim FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg GROUP BY tr.trdref ) SELECT ROUND(AVG(abm.avg_pas / MAX(0.01, abm.avg_patsim)), 2) AS average_updr_for_high_risk_manipulators FROM AdvancedBehaviorMetrics abm WHERE abm.tradereg IN (SELECT tradereg FROM HighRiskManipulators) LIMIT 100

query: I want to analyze the enforcement outcomes specifically for cases flagged as High-Intensity Insider Investigations. Could you provide a frequency count for each type of Penalty Imposed that resulted from these investigations? Please list the penalty types and their corresponding frequencies, ordered from the most frequent penalty to the least frequent.

query: I want to compare the performance of traders potentially involved in Peer Mimicry Suspicion versus other traders. Please calculate the average Risk-Adjusted Win Rate for these two groups. Display a boolean indicating if the group represents Peer Mimicry Suspicion (True) or not (False), and the corresponding average RAWR for that group, rounded to 2 decimal places.
sol_sql: WITH TraderPerformance AS ( SELECT tradereg, CAST(json_extract(trading_performance, '$.winpct') AS REAL) AS winpct, MAX(1, CAST(json_extract(trading_performance, '$.risklevel.levratio') AS REAL)) AS tle_floor1 FROM trader ), RAWR_Calculation AS ( SELECT tradereg, winpct / tle_floor1 AS rawr FROM TraderPerformance ), PeerMimicryFlags AS ( SELECT DISTINCT tr.trdref as tradereg, CASE WHEN ABS(ab.patsim - ab.peercorr) < 0.1 AND ab.peercorr > 0.7 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as is_mimicry_suspect FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg ) SELECT COALESCE(pmf.is_mimicry_suspect, FALSE) AS is_mimicry_suspect_group, ROUND(AVG(rc.rawr), 2) AS average_rawr FROM RAWR_Calculation rc LEFT JOIN PeerMimicryFlags pmf ON rc.tradereg = pmf.tradereg GROUP BY COALESCE(pmf.is_mimicry_suspect, FALSE) LIMIT 100

Then, calculate the average Order Modification Intensity across all transactions associated with this group. Provide just the calculated average OMI, rounded to four decimal places.
sol_sql: WITH EventDrivenTraders AS ( SELECT trdref AS tradereg, COUNT(*) AS total_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT sf.corpeventprx IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS event_transactions FROM transactionrecord AS tr LEFT JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS sf ON tr.transreg = sf.transref GROUP BY trdref HAVING CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT sf.corpeventprx IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) > 0.3 ), AggressiveSpeculators AS ( SELECT edt.tradereg FROM EventDrivenTraders AS edt JOIN trader AS t ON edt.tradereg = t.tradereg WHERE ( t.trading_performance -> '$.risklevel' ->> '$.risklevel' ) = 'Aggressive' ), VolatileSpeculators AS ( SELECT DISTINCT tr.trdref AS tradereg FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS sf ON tr.transreg = sf.transref JOIN AggressiveSpeculators AS ags ON tr.trdref = ags.tradereg WHERE ABS(sf.newsscore - sf.socscore) > 1.0 ), SpeculatorOMI AS ( SELECT vs.tradereg, tr.modfreq / NULLIF(1 - tr.cancelpct, 0) AS omi FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN VolatileSpeculators AS vs ON tr.trdref = vs.tradereg WHERE tr.cancelpct < 1 ) SELECT ROUND(AVG(omi), 4) AS average_omi_for_volatile_speculators FROM SpeculatorOMI LIMIT 100

query: Please create a reusable view named high_risk_trader_view that identifies traders fitting the High-Risk Trader Profile. sol_sql: CREATE VIEW high_risk_trader_view AS SELECT t.tradereg, t.tradekind, t.acctbal, ROUND(t.voldaily, 2), ROUND(COALESCE(t.voldaily / NULLIF(t.acctbal, 0), 0), 2) AS daily_turnover_rate, ROUND(COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.levratio'), 0), 2) AS trader_leverage_exposure, JSON_EXTRACT(t.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.risklevel') AS risk_level_text FROM trader t WHERE ( ROUND(COALESCE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.levratio'), 0), 2) > 5.0 AND JSON_EXTRACT(t.trading_performance, '$.risklevel.risklevel') = 'Aggressive' ) OR ( ROUND(COALESCE(t.voldaily / NULLIF(t.acctbal, 0), 0), 2) > 0.5 );

query: Please update the compliance risk score (risksc) in the compliancecase table for relevant cases. The new score should be calculated based on the Suspicious Activity Index. Make sure this update is only applied to compliance cases associated with transactions from the year 2024 onwards, and cap the resulting risksc value at a maximum of 100.
sol_sql: UPDATE compliancecase SET risksc = MIN(100, 0.3 * (CAST(json_extract(tr.risk_indicators, '$.spoofprob') AS REAL) / 100.0) + 0.2 * (CAST(json_extract(tr.risk_indicators, '$.frontscore') AS REAL) / 100.0) + 0.1 * (CAST(json_extract(tr.risk_indicators, '$.qstuffindex') AS REAL)) + 0.2 * CASE json_extract(tr.risk_indicators, '$.washsus') WHEN 'High' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.1 END + 0.2 * CASE json_extract(tr.risk_indicators, '$.layerind') WHEN 'Confirmed' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END ) FROM transactionrecord tr WHERE compliancecase.transref = tr.transreg AND strftime('%Y', tr.transtime) >= '2024'
test_cases:
def test_case(pred_sqls, sol_sqls, db_name, conn):
        def is_close_enough(a, b, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-9):
            return abs(float(a) - float(b)) <= max(rel_tol * max(abs(float(a)), abs(float(b))), abs_tol)
        get_id = f"""
        SELECT transreg FROM transactionrecord LIMIT 1;
        """
        res, _, _ = execute_queries([get_id], db_name, conn)
        transreg = res[0][0]
        get_actual_query = f"""
        SELECT
            tr.transreg,
            ( -- Start SAI calculation expression
                -- Weighted Spoofing Probability
                0.3 * (CAST(json_extract(tr.risk_indicators, '$.spoofprob') AS REAL) / 100.0) +
                -- Weighted Front Running Score
                0.2 * (CAST(json_extract(tr.risk_indicators, '$.frontscore') AS REAL) / 100.0) +
                -- Weighted Quote Stuffing Index
                0.1 * (CAST(json_extract(tr.risk_indicators, '$.qstuffindex') AS REAL)) +
                -- Weighted Wash Trading Suspicion
                0.2 * CASE json_extract(tr.risk_indicators, '$.washsus')
                        WHEN 'High' THEN 1.0
                        WHEN 'Medium' THEN 0.5
                        ELSE 0.1 -- Default to Low if missing or other value
                    END +
                -- Weighted Layering Indication
                0.2 * CASE json_extract(tr.risk_indicators, '$.layerind')
                        WHEN 'Confirmed' THEN 1.0
                        WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5
                        ELSE 0.0 -- Default to None if missing or other value
                    END
            ) AS calculated_sai -- Alias for the calculated score
        FROM
            transactionrecord tr
        WHERE
            tr.transreg = '{transreg}';  
        """
        res, _, _ = execute_queries([get_actual_query], db_name, conn)
        calculated_sai = res[0][1]
        verification_query = f"""
        SELECT risksc FROM compliancecase
        WHERE transref = '{transreg}'
        """
        res, _, _ = execute_queries([verification_query], db_name, conn)
        actual_sai = res[0][0]
        assert is_close_enough(calculated_sai, actual_sai), f"TEST CASE FAILED, expected {calculated_sai} got {actual_sai}"
        return True

query: Please create a view called 'trader_omi_distribution' that calculates the Order Modification Intensity (OMI) distribution statistics for all traders in the database. The view should use Common Table Expressions to first calculate OMI values for all valid transactions (where modfreq and cancelpct are not null and cancelpct < 1.0), then implement a manual median calculation using ROW_NUMBER() and window functions. The output should include trader_id, transaction_count, and the key OMI distribution statistics: min_omi, avg_omi, median_omi, and max_omi, grouped by trader reference.
sol_sql: CREATE VIEW trader_omi_distribution AS WITH TraderOMI AS (SELECT tr.trdref, tr.modfreq / NULLIF(1.0 - tr.cancelpct, 0.0) AS omi_value FROM transactionrecord tr WHERE tr.modfreq IS NOT NULL AND tr.cancelpct IS NOT NULL AND tr.cancelpct < 1.0), OMI_Ranked AS (SELECT trdref, omi_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY trdref ORDER BY omi_value) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY trdref) AS cnt FROM TraderOMI WHERE omi_value IS NOT NULL) SELECT trdref AS trader_id, COUNT(omi_value) AS transaction_count, MIN(omi_value) AS min_omi, AVG(omi_value) AS avg_omi, AVG(CASE WHEN rn >= cnt / 2.0 AND rn <= cnt / 2.0 + 1 THEN omi_value ELSE NULL END) AS median_omi, MAX(omi_value) AS max_omi FROM OMI_Ranked GROUP BY trdref;
test_cases:
def test_case(pred_sqls, sol_sqls, db_name, conn):
    import statistics
    def is_close_enough(a, b, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-9):
        return abs(float(a) - float(b)) <= max(rel_tol * max(abs(float(a)), abs(float(b))), abs_tol)
    get_id_query = f"""
    SELECT tr.trdref FROM transactionrecord tr
    WHERE tr.modfreq IS NOT NULL
      AND tr.cancelpct IS NOT NULL
      AND tr.cancelpct < 1.0
    GROUP BY tr.trdref
    HAVING COUNT(tr.trdref) > 1
    LIMIT 1;
    """
    res, _, _ = execute_queries([get_id_query], db_name, conn)
    trdref = res[0][0]
    find_omi_query = f"""
    SELECT
        tr.modfreq / NULLIF(1.0 - tr.cancelpct, 0.0) AS omi_value
    FROM transactionrecord tr
    WHERE tr.trdref = '{trdref}'
      AND tr.modfreq IS NOT NULL
      AND tr.cancelpct IS NOT NULL
      AND tr.cancelpct < 1.0
      AND NULLIF(1.0 - tr.cancelpct, 0.0) IS NOT NULL
    """
    res, _, _ = execute_queries([find_omi_query], db_name, conn)
    omi_values = [float(row[0]) for row in res if row[0] is not None]
    min_omi = min(omi_values)
    max_omi = max(omi_values)
    avg_omi = statistics.mean(omi_values)
    median_omi = statistics.median(omi_values)
    verification_query = f"""
    SELECT trader_id, transaction_count, min_omi, avg_omi, median_omi, max_omi
    FROM trader_omi_distribution
    WHERE trader_id = '{trdref}'
    """
    res, _, _ = execute_queries([verification_query], db_name, conn)
    _, _, min_db, avg_db, median_db, max_db = res[0]
    assert is_close_enough(min_omi, min_db), f"Min mismatch: {min_omi} vs {min_db}"
    assert is_close_enough(avg_omi, avg_db), f"Avg mismatch: {avg_omi} vs {avg_db}"
    assert is_close_enough(median_omi, median_db), f"Median mismatch: {median_omi} vs {median_db}"
    assert is_close_enough(max_omi, max_db), f"Max mismatch: {max_omi} vs {max_db}"
    return True

query: Please create a database trigger named 'prevent_premature_resolution_trigger' that attaches to the enforcementactions table and fires before update operations. The trigger should implement a Premature Resolution Block by using a WHEN clause to detect when resstat is being changed to 'Resolved', then calculate the Investigation Intensity Index (III) by joining investigationdetails and compliancecase tables. If the calculated III (using the formula: 0.6 * behansc + 0.4 * netansc) exceeds 75.0, the trigger should use RAISE(ABORT) to prevent the update with an appropriate error message about the threshold violation requiring further review.
sol_sql: CREATE TRIGGER prevent_premature_resolution_trigger BEFORE UPDATE ON enforcementactions FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.resstat = 'Resolved' AND OLD.resstat IS NOT 'Resolved' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Cannot resolve enforcement action: Associated Investigation Intensity Index is above threshold (75.0). Further review required.') FROM investigationdetails AS id JOIN compliancecase AS cc ON id.compref = cc.compreg WHERE cc.compreg = NEW.compref2 AND (0.6 * COALESCE(id.behansc, 0)) + (0.4 * COALESCE(id.netansc, 0)) > 75.0; END;
test_cases:
def test_case(pred_sqls, sol_sqls, db_name, conn):
    sample_query = f"""
    UPDATE enforcementactions
    SET resstat = 'Resolved'
    WHERE enforcereg = (
        SELECT ea.enforcereg
        FROM enforcementactions AS ea
        JOIN compliancecase AS cc ON ea.compreg2 = cc.compreg
        JOIN investigationdetails AS id ON id.compref = cc.compreg
        WHERE (0.6 * COALESCE(id.behansc, 0)) + (0.4 * COALESCE(id.netansc, 0)) > 75.0
          AND ea.resstat IS NOT 'Resolved'
        LIMIT 1
    );
    """

query: Please update the advancedbehavior table to replace the existing peercorr values with a normalized score. Specifically, calculate the Peer Correlation Z-Score for each record. Only update records where peercorr is not initially NULL, and handle cases with zero standard deviation within a tradekind by setting the Z-score to 0. After performing the update, return the abhvreg and the new peercorr (Z-score) for all updated rows.
sol_sql: WITH PeerCorrStats AS (SELECT ab.abhvreg, ab.peercorr, t.tradekind, AVG(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind) AS avg_peercorr, COUNT(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind) AS count_peercorr, AVG(ab.peercorr * ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind) AS avg_sq_peercorr FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg WHERE ab.peercorr IS NOT NULL) UPDATE advancedbehavior SET peercorr = (SELECT ROUND(CASE WHEN pcs.count_peercorr <= 1 OR (pcs.avg_sq_peercorr - pcs.avg_peercorr * pcs.avg_peercorr) <= 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE (pcs.peercorr - pcs.avg_peercorr) / SQRT((pcs.avg_sq_peercorr - pcs.avg_peercorr * pcs.avg_peercorr) * pcs.count_peercorr / (pcs.count_peercorr - 1)) END, 4) FROM PeerCorrStats AS pcs WHERE pcs.abhvreg = advancedbehavior.abhvreg) WHERE abhvreg IN (SELECT abhvreg FROM PeerCorrStats) RETURNING abhvreg, peercorr;
test_cases:
def test_case(pred_sqls, sol_sqls, db_name, conn):
    import statistics
    def is_close_enough(a, b, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-9):
        return abs(float(a) - float(b)) <= max(rel_tol * max(abs(float(a)), abs(float(b))), abs_tol)
    select_record_query = """
    SELECT ab.abhvreg, ab.peercorr, t.tradekind
    FROM advancedbehavior ab
    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
    JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
    WHERE ab.peercorr IS NOT NULL
    LIMIT 1;
    """
    res, _, _ = execute_queries([select_record_query], db_name, conn)
    abhvreg, original_peercorr, tradekind = res[0]
    get_partition_query = f"""
    SELECT ab.peercorr
    FROM advancedbehavior ab
    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
    JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
    WHERE ab.peercorr IS NOT NULL AND t.tradekind = '{tradekind}';
    """
    res, _, _ = execute_queries([get_partition_query], db_name, conn)
    peercorr_values = [float(row[0]) for row in res]
    mean = statistics.mean(peercorr_values)
    stddev = statistics.stdev(peercorr_values) if len(peercorr_values) > 1 else 0
    expected_z_score = 0 if stddev == 0 else round((float(original_peercorr) - mean) / stddev, 4)
    updated_rows, _, _ = execute_queries(pred_sqls, db_name, conn)
    check_updated_query = f"SELECT peercorr FROM advancedbehavior WHERE abhvreg = '{abhvreg}';"
    res, _, _ = execute_queries([check_updated_query], db_name, conn)
    updated_peercorr = float(res[0][0])
    assert is_close_enough(updated_peercorr, expected_z_score), f"Z-score mismatch for abhvreg {abhvreg}: expected {expected_z_score}, got {updated_peercorr}"
    return True

query: I want to identify High-Risk Patients from facilities experiencing Severe Environmental Stress or Severe Life Impact, who also exhibit low Therapy Engagement Scores (average TES is lower than 2). For each patient, include their patient ID, assessment ID, date of their most recent assessment, their average rounded TES score, and the environmental stress or life impact level of the facility they are associated with. Focus only on the most recent assessments and prioritize patients meeting all these criteria. Sort the results by the assessment date in descending order and limit to the top 50 results.
sol_sql: WITH PatientRisk AS ( SELECT ab.patownerref AS patkey, asr.asrkey, asr.suicrisk, CAST(( asr.mental_health_scores -> '$.depression' ->> '$.phq9_score' ) AS INTEGER) AS phq9_score, CAST(( asr.mental_health_scores -> '$.anxiety' ->> '$.gad7_score' ) AS INTEGER) AS gad7_score, TRUE AS is_high_risk FROM assessmentbasics AS ab JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk AS asr ON ab.abkey = asr.asrkey WHERE asr.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe') OR CAST(( asr.mental_health_scores -> '$.depression' ->> '$.phq9_score' ) AS INTEGER) > 15 OR CAST(( asr.mental_health_scores -> '$.anxiety' ->> '$.gad7_score' ) AS INTEGER) > 15 ), FacilityStress AS ( SELECT fackey, envstress, lifeimpact FROM facilities WHERE envstress = 'Severe' OR lifeimpact = 'Severe' ), PatientEngagement AS ( SELECT tb.encref, e.patref AS patkey, CASE ( tb.therapy_details ->> '$.engagement' ) WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END AS engagement_score FROM treatmentbasics AS tb JOIN encounters AS e ON tb.encref = e.enckey WHERE NOT tb.therapy_details IS NULL ), AvgPatientEngagement AS ( SELECT patkey, ROUND(AVG(engagement_score)) AS avg_engagement_score FROM PatientEngagement GROUP BY patkey ), RecentAssessment AS ( SELECT pr.patkey, pr.asrkey, pr.is_high_risk, e.facid, e.timemark, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pr.patkey ORDER BY e.timemark DESC NULLS FIRST) AS rn FROM PatientRisk AS pr JOIN encounters AS e ON pr.asrkey = e.abref ) SELECT ra.patkey, ra.asrkey, ra.timemark AS last_assessment_date, ape.avg_engagement_score AS patient_tes_avg, fs.envstress, fs.lifeimpact FROM RecentAssessment AS ra JOIN AvgPatientEngagement AS ape ON ra.patkey = ape.patkey LEFT JOIN FacilityStress AS fs ON ra.facid = fs.fackey WHERE ra.rn = 1 AND ape.avg_engagement_score < 2 AND NOT fs.fackey IS NULL ORDER BY ra.timemark DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 50

query: Identify facilities exhibiting characteristics of a Systemically Stressed Facility Environment. For each facility, return its ID and Resource-Demand Differential value, limited to the top 100 facilities.
sol_sql: WITH FacilityPFIS AS ( SELECT e.facid, AVG( CASE asd.funcimp WHEN 'Severe' THEN 3 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Mild' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS pfis FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis AS asd JOIN assessmentbasics AS ab ON asd.asdkey = ab.abkey JOIN encounters AS e ON ab.abkey = e.abref WHERE NOT e.facid IS NULL AND NOT asd.funcimp IS NULL GROUP BY e.facid ), FacilityFRAI AS ( SELECT fackey AS facid, CASE ( support_and_resources ->> '$.community_resources' ) WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS frai FROM facilities WHERE NOT support_and_resources ->> '$.community_resources' IS NULL ), FacilityRDD AS ( SELECT pfis.facid, ROUND(( pfis.pfis - ff.frai ), 2) AS rdd FROM FacilityPFIS AS pfis JOIN FacilityFRAI AS ff ON pfis.facid = ff.facid ), FacilityTES AS ( SELECT e.facid, AVG( CASE ( tb.therapy_details ->> '$.engagement' ) WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END ) AS avg_tes FROM treatmentbasics AS tb JOIN encounters AS e ON tb.encref = e.enckey WHERE NOT tb.therapy_details IS NULL AND NOT e.facid IS NULL GROUP BY e.facid ), FacilityTAR AS ( SELECT e.facid, CASE WHEN COUNT(tro.txoutkey) > 0 THEN CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE tro.txadh IN ('High', 'Medium')) AS REAL) / COUNT(tro.txoutkey) ELSE 0 END AS tar FROM treatmentoutcomes AS tro JOIN treatmentbasics AS tb ON tro.txref = tb.txkey JOIN encounters AS e ON tb.encref = e.enckey WHERE NOT e.facid IS NULL GROUP BY e.facid ), FacilityEAS AS ( SELECT tes.facid, ( tes.avg_tes + ( tar.tar * 3.0 ) ) / 2.0 AS eas FROM FacilityTES AS tes JOIN FacilityTAR AS tar ON tes.facid = tar.facid ), FacilityMAR AS ( SELECT facid, AVG(COALESCE(missappt, 0)) AS mar FROM encounters WHERE NOT facid IS NULL GROUP BY facid ), AttritionRiskFacilities AS ( SELECT feas.facid FROM FacilityEAS AS feas JOIN FacilityMAR AS fmar ON feas.facid = fmar.facid WHERE feas.eas < 1.5 AND fmar.mar > 2.5 ) SELECT frdd.facid, frdd.rdd FROM FacilityRDD AS frdd WHERE frdd.rdd > 1.0 AND frdd.facid IN ( SELECT facid FROM AttritionRiskFacilities ) ORDER BY frdd.rdd DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

query: For all facilities, I want to explore the Correlation Between Resource Adequacy and Adherence. Include the overall Facility Resource Adequacy Index as a reference and the correlation coefficient between each facility's resource adequacy score and treatment adherence rate. Exclude facilities with no applicable TAR.
sol_sql: WITH FacilityResources AS ( SELECT fackey, CASE json_extract(support_and_resources, '$.community_resources') WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS resource_score FROM facilities WHERE support_and_resources IS NOT NULL ), FacilityAdherence AS ( SELECT e.facid, COUNT(*) AS total_outcomes, SUM(CASE WHEN tro.txadh IN ('High', 'Medium') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS adherent_outcomes FROM treatmentoutcomes tro JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tro.txref = tb.txkey JOIN encounters e ON tb.encref = e.enckey WHERE e.facid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.facid ), FacilityMetrics AS ( SELECT fr.fackey, fr.resource_score, CASE WHEN fa.total_outcomes > 0 THEN CAST(fa.adherent_outcomes AS REAL) / fa.total_outcomes ELSE 0 END AS tar FROM FacilityResources fr LEFT JOIN FacilityAdherence fa ON fr.fackey = fa.facid ), OverallFRAI AS ( SELECT AVG(resource_score) AS frai FROM FacilityResources ), CorrelationData AS ( SELECT (SELECT frai FROM OverallFRAI) AS overall_frai, resource_score, tar FROM FacilityMetrics WHERE tar > 0 ) SELECT overall_frai, ( SELECT SUM((resource_score - (SELECT AVG(resource_score) FROM CorrelationData)) * (tar - (SELECT AVG(tar) FROM CorrelationData))) / (SQRT(SUM((resource_score - (SELECT AVG(resource_score) FROM CorrelationData)) * (resource_score - (SELECT AVG(resource_score) FROM CorrelationData)))) * SQRT(SUM((tar - (SELECT AVG(tar) FROM CorrelationData)) * (tar - (SELECT AVG(tar) FROM CorrelationData))))) FROM CorrelationData ) AS correlation_frai_tar FROM (SELECT DISTINCT overall_frai FROM CorrelationData)

query: Identify facilities classified as having a Facility with Potential Engagement-Outcome Disconnect. Display the facility ID, the average TES, and the RTI for these facilities. Round both TES and RTI to 2 decimal places, sort by facility ID, and limit the output to 100 rows.
sol_sql: WITH TherapyEngagement AS ( SELECT e.facid, tb.txkey, CASE ( tb.therapy_details ->> '$.engagement' ) WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END AS engagement_score FROM treatmentbasics AS tb JOIN encounters AS e ON tb.encref = e.enckey WHERE NOT tb.therapy_details IS NULL AND NOT e.facid IS NULL ), FacilityTES AS ( SELECT facid, ROUND(AVG(engagement_score), 2) AS avg_tes FROM TherapyEngagement GROUP BY facid ), FunctionalImprovement AS ( SELECT e.facid, tro.txoutkey, CASE tro.funcimpv WHEN 'Significant' THEN 3 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Minimal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS funcimpv_score, CASE WHEN tro.txadh IN ('High', 'Medium') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_adherent FROM treatmentoutcomes AS tro JOIN treatmentbasics AS tb ON tro.txref = tb.txkey JOIN encounters AS e ON tb.encref = e.enckey WHERE NOT e.facid IS NULL ), FacilityRTI AS ( SELECT facid, AVG(funcimpv_score) AS avg_funcimpv_score, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(is_adherent) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) ELSE 0 END AS tar, ROUND( ( AVG(funcimpv_score) * CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(is_adherent) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) ELSE 0 END ), 2 ) AS rti FROM FunctionalImprovement GROUP BY facid ) SELECT ft.facid, ft.avg_tes, fr.rti FROM FacilityTES AS ft JOIN FacilityRTI AS fr ON ft.facid = fr.facid WHERE ft.avg_tes > 2.0 AND fr.rti < 0.8 ORDER BY ft.facid NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

query: I want to identify the top-performing clinicians in Resource-Supported Facilities based on their Patient Stability Metric. For each clinician, provide their ID, the facility ID, their PSM score, and their rank within the facility. The rank should be based on PSM, with higher PSM scores ranked higher. Only include clinicians from facilities classified as Resource-Supported Facilities. Sort the results by facility ID and then by rank within each facility, limiting the output to the top 100 rows.
sol_sql: WITH FacilityResourceScores AS ( SELECT fackey, CASE ( support_and_resources ->> '$.community_resources' ) WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS resource_score FROM facilities WHERE NOT support_and_resources ->> '$.community_resources' IS NULL ), ResourceSupportedFacilities AS ( SELECT fackey FROM FacilityResourceScores WHERE resource_score >= 2 ), PatientMetrics AS ( SELECT e.patref AS patkey, e.clinid, e.facid, COALESCE(tb.crisisint, 0) AS crisisint, COALESCE(e.missappt, 0) AS missappt, e.enckey FROM encounters AS e LEFT JOIN treatmentbasics AS tb ON e.enckey = tb.encref WHERE NOT e.clinid IS NULL AND e.facid IN ( SELECT fackey FROM ResourceSupportedFacilities ) ), ClinicianAvgMetrics AS ( SELECT clinid, facid, SUM(crisisint) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT patkey), 0) AS REAL) AS avg_cif, SUM(missappt) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT patkey), 0) AS REAL) AS avg_mar FROM PatientMetrics GROUP BY clinid, facid ), ClinicianPSM AS ( SELECT clinid, facid, avg_cif, avg_mar, ROUND(1.0 / ( 1.0 + avg_cif + avg_mar ), 2) AS psm FROM ClinicianAvgMetrics ) SELECT clinid, facid, psm, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY facid ORDER BY psm DESC NULLS FIRST, clinid NULLS LAST) AS rank_within_facility FROM ClinicianPSM ORDER BY facid NULLS LAST, rank_within_facility NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

query: I want to find patients who are exhibiting fragile stability. List each patients ID, their average missed appointments, and their most recent SSE score.
sol_sql: WITH StablePatients AS ( SELECT asd.asdkey, ab.patownerref as patkey FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON asd.asdkey = ab.abkey WHERE asd.recstatus = 'Stable' ), PatientAvgMissedAppts AS ( SELECT patref AS patkey, ROUND(AVG(missappt)) AS avg_missappt FROM encounters WHERE missappt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY patref ), PatientSocialSupport AS ( SELECT ab.patownerref AS patkey, asd.asdkey, (CASE asd.socsup WHEN 'Strong' THEN 3 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE asd.relqual WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 2 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 1 WHEN 'Conflicted' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END) AS sse_score FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON asd.asdkey = ab.abkey ), LatestPatientSSE AS ( SELECT sp.patkey, MAX(pss.sse_score) AS sse_score FROM StablePatients sp JOIN PatientSocialSupport pss ON sp.patkey = pss.patkey JOIN encounters e ON pss.asdkey = e.abref AND e.patref = sp.patkey GROUP BY sp.patkey ) SELECT sp.patkey, pama.avg_missappt, lsse.sse_score FROM StablePatients sp JOIN PatientAvgMissedAppts pama ON sp.patkey = pama.patkey JOIN LatestPatientSSE lsse ON sp.patkey = lsse.patkey WHERE pama.avg_missappt > 2 OR lsse.sse_score < 3

query: I want to identify which primary diagnoses are associated with the highest Crisis Intervention Frequency (CIF) across all patients. For each diagnosis, list the diagnosis name, the number of patients with that diagnosis, and the CIF value, rounded to two decimal places. Sort the results by CIF in descending order and limit to the top 100 diagnoses.
sol_sql: WITH PatientDiagnosis AS ( SELECT patownerref AS patkey, primdx FROM ( SELECT ab.patownerref, asd.primdx, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ab.patownerref ORDER BY e.timemark DESC) as rn FROM assessmentbasics ab JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON ab.abkey = asd.asdkey JOIN encounters e ON ab.abkey = e.abref WHERE asd.primdx IS NOT NULL ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ), PatientCrisisInterventions AS ( SELECT e.patref AS patkey, SUM(COALESCE(tb.crisisint, 0)) AS total_crisisint FROM treatmentbasics tb JOIN encounters e ON tb.encref = e.enckey GROUP BY e.patref ), PatientCount AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patkey) AS total_patients FROM patients ) SELECT pd.primdx, COUNT(DISTINCT pci.patkey) AS num_patients_with_dx, ROUND(CAST(SUM(pci.total_crisisint) AS REAL) / pc.total_patients, 2) AS cif_per_diagnosis FROM PatientDiagnosis pd JOIN PatientCrisisInterventions pci ON pd.patkey = pci.patkey CROSS JOIN PatientCount pc GROUP BY pd.primdx, pc.total_patients ORDER BY cif_per_diagnosis DESC LIMIT 100

query: I want to categorize facilities into performance quadrants. For each facility, list the facility ID, Treatment Adherence Rate (rounded to two decimal places), Patient Stability Metric (rounded to two decimal places), and the performance quadrant. Sort results by performance quadrant and facility ID, limiting to the top 100 facilities.
sol_sql: WITH FacilityAdherence AS ( SELECT e.facid, CASE WHEN COUNT(tro.txoutkey) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN tro.txadh IN ('High', 'Medium') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(tro.txoutkey) ELSE 0 END AS tar FROM treatmentoutcomes tro JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tro.txref = tb.txkey JOIN encounters e ON tb.encref = e.enckey WHERE e.facid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.facid ), FacilityPatientCount AS ( SELECT e.facid, COUNT(DISTINCT e.patref) AS total_patients FROM encounters e WHERE e.facid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.facid ), FacilityStabilityMetrics AS ( SELECT e.facid, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(tb.crisisint, 0)) / NULLIF(fpc.total_patients, 0), 0) AS cif, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(e.missappt, 0)) / NULLIF(fpc.total_patients, 0), 0) AS mar FROM encounters e LEFT JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON e.enckey = tb.encref JOIN FacilityPatientCount fpc ON e.facid = fpc.facid WHERE e.facid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.facid, fpc.total_patients ), FacilityPSM AS ( SELECT facid, cif, mar, 1.0 / (1.0 + cif + mar) AS psm FROM FacilityStabilityMetrics ), FacilityMetrics AS ( SELECT fa.facid, fa.tar, fp.psm FROM FacilityAdherence fa JOIN FacilityPSM fp ON fa.facid = fp.facid ), Thresholds AS ( SELECT ( SELECT tar FROM ( SELECT tar FROM FacilityMetrics ORDER BY tar LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT (COUNT(*) - 1) / 2 FROM FacilityMetrics) ) ) AS median_tar, ( SELECT psm FROM ( SELECT psm FROM FacilityMetrics ORDER BY psm LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT (COUNT(*) - 1) / 2 FROM FacilityMetrics) ) ) AS median_psm ) SELECT fm.facid, ROUND(fm.tar, 2) AS tar, ROUND(fm.psm, 2) AS psm, CASE WHEN fm.tar >= t.median_tar AND fm.psm >= t.median_psm THEN 'High Adherence, High Stability' WHEN fm.tar >= t.median_tar AND fm.psm < t.median_psm THEN 'High Adherence, Low Stability' WHEN fm.tar < t.median_tar AND fm.psm >= t.median_psm THEN 'Low Adherence, High Stability' ELSE 'Low Adherence, Low Stability' END AS performance_quadrant FROM FacilityMetrics fm, Thresholds t ORDER BY performance_quadrant, fm.facid LIMIT 100

query: Analyze the impact of therapy changes (modality, therapist, frequency) on the Therapy Engagement Score and calculate the engagement variation for each change type. Show the change type, total occurrences, average scores before (previous encounter of each encounter) and after (current encounter), and average score change from previous score to current score, ordering by total occurrences in descending order.
sol_sql: WITH TherapyDetails AS ( SELECT e.patref AS patkey, tb.txkey, e.timemark AS encounter_time, tb.therapy_details ->> '$.type' AS therapy_type, tb.therapy_details ->> '$.changes' AS therapy_change, CASE ( tb.therapy_details ->> '$.engagement' ) WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS engagement_score FROM treatmentbasics AS tb JOIN encounters AS e ON tb.encref = e.enckey WHERE NOT tb.therapy_details IS NULL ), EngagementChanges AS ( SELECT patkey, txkey, encounter_time, therapy_change, engagement_score, LAG(engagement_score, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY patkey ORDER BY encounter_time NULLS LAST) AS prev_engagement_score FROM TherapyDetails ) SELECT therapy_change, COUNT(*) AS total_records, ROUND(CAST(AVG(prev_engagement_score) AS REAL), 2) AS avg_previous_score, ROUND(CAST(AVG(engagement_score) AS REAL), 2) AS avg_current_score, ROUND( CAST(AVG( CASE WHEN NOT prev_engagement_score IS NULL THEN engagement_score - prev_engagement_score END ) AS REAL), 2 ) AS avg_engagement_score_change FROM EngagementChanges WHERE NOT therapy_change IS NULL GROUP BY therapy_change ORDER BY total_records DESC NULLS FIRST

query: For facilities with high Suicide Risk Prevalence over 20%, calculate the Resource-Demand Differential. List the facility ID, PFIS, FRAI, and RDD scores, ordered by RDD from highest to lowest, showing the top 100 facilities. This helps identify resource gaps in critical environments.
sol_sql: WITH FacilitySRP AS ( SELECT e.facid, COUNT(*) AS total_assessments, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE asr.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe')) AS high_risk_assessments, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN ( CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE asr.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe')) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) ) ELSE 0 END AS srp FROM assessmentsymptomsandrisk AS asr JOIN assessmentbasics AS ab ON asr.asrkey = ab.abkey JOIN encounters AS e ON ab.abkey = e.abref WHERE NOT e.facid IS NULL GROUP BY e.facid ), HighSRPFacilities AS ( SELECT facid FROM FacilitySRP WHERE srp > 20.0 ), FacilityPFIS AS ( SELECT e.facid, ROUND( AVG( CASE asd.funcimp WHEN 'Severe' THEN 3 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Mild' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) ) AS pfis FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis AS asd JOIN assessmentbasics AS ab ON asd.asdkey = ab.abkey JOIN encounters AS e ON ab.abkey = e.abref WHERE e.facid IN ( SELECT facid FROM HighSRPFacilities ) AND NOT asd.funcimp IS NULL GROUP BY e.facid ), FacilityFRAI AS ( SELECT f.fackey AS facid, ROUND( AVG( CASE ( f.support_and_resources ->> '$.community_resources' ) WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) ) AS frai FROM facilities AS f WHERE f.fackey IN ( SELECT facid FROM HighSRPFacilities ) AND NOT f.support_and_resources ->> '$.community_resources' IS NULL GROUP BY f.fackey ) SELECT hspf.facid, fpf.pfis, ffr.frai, ( fpf.pfis - ffr.frai ) AS rdd FROM HighSRPFacilities AS hspf JOIN FacilityPFIS AS fpf ON hspf.facid = fpf.facid JOIN FacilityFRAI AS ffr ON hspf.facid = ffr.facid ORDER BY rdd DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

query: Please update the patients table. For every patient identified as a High-Risk Patient based on their latest one assessment data, set the value in their risk_level column to 'High Risk'. If the risk_level column doesn't exists, create it with type VARCHAR(20)
sol_sql: ALTER TABLE patients ADD COLUMN risk_level VARCHAR(20);

WITH LatestAssessments AS ( SELECT e.patref, asr.asrkey, asr.suicrisk, asr.mental_health_scores, e.timemark, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.patref ORDER BY e.timemark DESC) as rn FROM encounters e JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON e.abref = ab.abkey JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk asr ON ab.abkey = asr.asrkey ), FilteredAssessments AS ( SELECT patref, asrkey, suicrisk, mental_health_scores FROM LatestAssessments WHERE rn = 1 ), HighRiskPatients AS ( SELECT la.patref FROM FilteredAssessments la WHERE la.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe') OR (CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(la.mental_health_scores, '$.depression.phq9_score'), '[', ''), ']', '') AS INTEGER) > 15) OR (CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(la.mental_health_scores, '$.anxiety.gad7_score'), '[', ''), ']', '') AS INTEGER) > 15) ) UPDATE patients SET risk_level = 'High Risk' WHERE patkey IN (SELECT patref FROM HighRiskPatients);
test_cases:
def test_case(pred_sqls, sol_sqls, db_name, conn):
        sample_query = f"""
        SELECT patkey, risk_level
        FROM patients
        WHERE risk_level IS NOT NULL
        LIMIT 1;
        """
        res, _, _ = execute_queries([sample_query], db_name, conn)
        assert len(res) > 0, "Test case failed: No rows with risk_level found in patients table."
        patkey = res[0][0]
        confirm_high_risk = f"""
        WITH LatestAssessments AS (
            SELECT
                e.patref,
                asr.asrkey,
                asr.suicrisk,
                asr.mental_health_scores,
                e.timemark,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.patref ORDER BY e.timemark DESC) as rn
            FROM encounters e
            JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON e.abref = ab.abkey
            JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk asr ON ab.abkey = asr.asrkey
        ),
        FilteredAssessments AS (
            SELECT patref, asrkey, suicrisk, mental_health_scores
            FROM LatestAssessments
            WHERE rn = 1
        ),
        HighRiskPatients AS (
            SELECT
                la.patref
            FROM FilteredAssessments la
            WHERE
                la.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe')
                OR
                (CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(la.mental_health_scores, '$.depression.phq9_score'), '[', ''), ']', '') AS INTEGER) > 15)
                OR
                (CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(JSON_EXTRACT(la.mental_health_scores, '$.anxiety.gad7_score'), '[', ''), ']', '') AS INTEGER) > 15)
        )
        SELECT patref FROM HighRiskPatients WHERE patref = '{patkey}';
        """
        res, _, _ = execute_queries([confirm_high_risk], db_name, conn)
        assert len(res) > 0 and res[0][0] == patkey, f"Test case failed: patkey {patkey} marked as 'high' risk but does not meet high-risk criteria."
        return True

query: Please create an Encounter Audit Log table (high_risk_encounter_audit) if one doesn't exist. Then, identify all encounters where the patient is considered part of the High Severity, High Risk Patient Group. For each of these encounters, insert the audit id, encounter key, patient key, clinician ID, and facility ID into the Encounter Audit Log. Also record the current timestamp and the reason 'High Severity and High Suicide Risk' for each entry.
sol_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS high_risk_encounter_audit ( audit_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, enckey TEXT NOT NULL, patkey TEXT NOT NULL, clinid TEXT, facid TEXT, audit_timestamp TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), reason TEXT );

WITH PatientRiskProfile AS ( SELECT e.enckey, e.patref, e.clinid, e.facid, asr.suicrisk, asr.mental_health_scores FROM encounters e JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk asr ON e.abref = asr.asrkey ) INSERT INTO high_risk_encounter_audit (enckey, patkey, clinid, facid, reason) SELECT prp.enckey, prp.patref, prp.clinid, prp.facid, 'High Severity and High Suicide Risk' FROM PatientRiskProfile prp WHERE ( COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(prp.mental_health_scores, '$.depression.phq9_score') AS INTEGER), 0) > 19 OR COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(prp.mental_health_scores, '$.anxiety.gad7_score') AS INTEGER), 0) > 14 ) AND prp.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe');
test_cases:
def test_case(pred_sqls, sol_sqls, db_name, conn):
        sample_query = f"""
        SELECT * FROM high_risk_encounter_audit
        WHERE audit_id IS NOT NULL
        LIMIT 1;
        """
        res, _, _ = execute_queries([sample_query], db_name, conn)
        assert len(res) > 0, "Test case failed: No rows with audit_id found in high_risk_encounter_audit table."
        patkey = res[0][2]
        confirm = f"""
        WITH PatientRiskProfile AS (
            SELECT
                e.enckey,
                e.patref,
                e.clinid,
                e.facid,
                asr.suicrisk,
                asr.mental_health_scores
            FROM encounters e
            JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk asr ON e.abref = asr.asrkey
            WHERE
            (
                COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(asr.mental_health_scores, '$.depression.phq9_score') AS INTEGER), 0) > 19
                OR
                COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(asr.mental_health_scores, '$.anxiety.gad7_score') AS INTEGER), 0) > 14
            )
            AND
            asr.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe')
        ) SELECT patref FROM PatientRiskProfile WHERE patref = '{res[0][2]}';
        """
        res, _, _ = execute_queries([confirm], db_name, conn)
        assert len(res) > 0 and res[0][0] == patkey, f"Test case failed: patkey {patkey} marked as 'high' severity but does not meet high-severity criteria."
        return True

query: Please remove Stale Treatment Outcome Records from the treatmentoutcomes table, but only for patients who have been identified as Non-Compliant Patient.
sol_sql: WITH NonCompliantPatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT p.patkey FROM patients p JOIN encounters e ON p.patkey = e.patref JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON e.enckey = tb.encref JOIN treatmentoutcomes txo ON tb.txkey = txo.txref WHERE tb.medadh = 'Non-compliant' AND txo.txadh = 'Non-compliant' ), StaleOutcomesToDelete AS ( SELECT txo.txoutkey FROM treatmentoutcomes txo JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON txo.txref = tb.txkey JOIN encounters e ON tb.encref = e.enckey WHERE e.patref IN (SELECT patkey FROM NonCompliantPatients) AND julianday('now') - julianday(e.timemark) > 60 ) DELETE FROM treatmentoutcomes WHERE txoutkey IN (SELECT txoutkey FROM StaleOutcomesToDelete);
test_cases:
def test_case(pred_sqls, sol_sqls, db_name, conn):
        sample_query = f"""
        WITH NonCompliantPatients AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT p.patkey
            FROM patients p
            JOIN encounters e ON p.patkey = e.patref
            JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON e.enckey = tb.encref
            JOIN treatmentoutcomes txo ON tb.txkey = txo.txref
            WHERE tb.medadh = 'Non-compliant' AND txo.txadh = 'Non-compliant'
        ),
        StaleOutcomesToDelete AS (
            SELECT txo.txoutkey
            FROM treatmentoutcomes txo
            JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON txo.txref = tb.txkey
            JOIN encounters e ON tb.encref = e.enckey
            WHERE e.patref IN (SELECT patkey FROM NonCompliantPatients)
            AND julianday('now') - julianday(e.timemark) > 60
        )
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS remaining_matches
        FROM treatmentoutcomes txo
        WHERE txo.txoutkey IN (SELECT txoutkey FROM StaleOutcomesToDelete);
        """
        res, _, _ = execute_queries([sample_query], db_name, conn)
        assert res[0][0] == 0, f"Test case failed: {res[0][0]} rows still meet the condition after delete"
        return True

query: Please create a view named 'calculate_tes_view' that calculates the Therapy Engagement Score (TES) for all treatment records in the database. The view should extract the 'engagement' level from the JSON therapy_details field using json_extract and apply the standard TES scoring logic (High=3, Medium=2, Low=1, Non-compliant=0, with 0 as default for any other values). Include the treatment key (txkey) and calculated TES score (tes_score) in the results, filtering to only include records where therapy_details is not null.

query: Identify all High-Value Artifacts. Show me their ID, name, insured value, conservation status and the High-Value Category. Only include high-value artifacts with 'Critical' conservation status.
sol_sql: WITH artifact_rankings AS ( SELECT a.ArtRegistry, a.ArtName, a.ConserveStatus, sec.InsValueUSD, r.HistSignRating, r.CultScore, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY r.HistSignRating DESC NULLS FIRST) AS hist_percentile, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY r.CultScore DESC NULLS FIRST) AS cult_percentile FROM ArtifactsCore AS a JOIN ArtifactRatings AS r ON a.ArtRegistry = r.ArtRef JOIN ArtifactSecurityAccess AS sec ON a.ArtRegistry = sec.ArtRef ) SELECT ArtRegistry, ArtName, InsValueUSD, ConserveStatus, CASE WHEN InsValueUSD > 1000000 THEN 'Monetary High-Value' WHEN hist_percentile = 1 AND cult_percentile = 1 THEN 'Cultural/Historical High-Value' ELSE 'Other' END AS value_category FROM artifact_rankings WHERE ConserveStatus = 'Critical' AND ( InsValueUSD > 1000000 OR ( hist_percentile = 1 AND cult_percentile = 1 ) )

query: Generate a rotation schedule using the standard ERPS formula. Show me each artifact's ID, name, material type, current display duration, their Display Safety Duration (DSD) limit, the calculated ERPS and a clear recommendation ('Immediate Rotation' or 'Monitor') based on ERPS Decision Threshold. Only include artifacts currently marked as 'Active' in the rotation schedule.
sol_sql: WITH erf_calc AS ( SELECT a.ArtRegistry, a.ArtName, AVG(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(s.EnvSensitivity))='high' THEN 10 WHEN LOWER(TRIM(s.EnvSensitivity))='medium' THEN 5 WHEN LOWER(TRIM(s.EnvSensitivity))='low' THEN 1 END) AS ERF FROM ArtifactsCore a LEFT JOIN SensitivityData s ON s.ArtRef = a.ArtRegistry GROUP BY a.ArtRegistry, a.ArtName ), high_sens AS ( SELECT s.ArtRef, json_group_array(json_object('type','EnvSensitivity','value', s.EnvSensitivity)) AS high_sensitivities FROM SensitivityData s WHERE LOWER(TRIM(s.EnvSensitivity))='high' GROUP BY s.ArtRef ) SELECT ec.ArtRegistry, ec.ArtName, ROUND(ec.ERF,2) AS ERF, COALESCE(hs.high_sensitivities,'[]') AS high_sensitivities FROM erf_calc ec LEFT JOIN high_sens hs ON hs.ArtRef = ec.ArtRegistry WHERE ec.ERF > 7 ORDER BY ec.ERF DESC;

query: I want to identify artifacts with dangerously high environmental risks by calculating their Environmental Risk Factor (ERF). Could you show me each artifact's ID, name, calculated ERF score, and a JSON summary of all its 'High' sensitivity ratings (e.g., [{"type": "LightSensitivity", "value": "High"}, {"type": "TempSensitivity", "value": "High"}])? Only include artifacts where the ERF exceeds the critical threshold of 7, sorted from highest to lowest risk.
sol_sql: WITH erf_calc AS ( SELECT a.artregistry, a.artname, AVG(CASE WHEN lower(trim(s.envsensitivity))='high' THEN 10 WHEN lower(trim(s.envsensitivity))='medium' THEN 5 WHEN lower(trim(s.envsensitivity))='low' THEN 1 END) AS ERF FROM artifactscore a LEFT JOIN sensitivitydata s ON s.artref = a.artregistry GROUP BY a.artregistry, a.artname ), high_sens AS ( SELECT t.artref, json_group_array(json_object('type', t.k, 'value', t.v)) AS high_sensitivities FROM ( SELECT s.artref, 'EnvSensitivity' AS k, s.envsensitivity AS v FROM sensitivitydata s WHERE lower(trim(s.envsensitivity))='high' UNION ALL SELECT s.artref, 'LightSensitivity', s.lightsensitivity FROM sensitivitydata s WHERE lower(trim(s.lightsensitivity))='high' UNION ALL SELECT s.artref, 'TempSensitivity', s.tempsensitivity FROM sensitivitydata s WHERE lower(trim(s.tempsensitivity))='high' UNION ALL SELECT s.artref, 'HumiditySensitivity', s.humiditysensitivity FROM sensitivitydata s WHERE lower(trim(s.humiditysensitivity))='high' UNION ALL SELECT s.artref, 'VibraSensitivity', s.vibrasensitivity FROM sensitivitydata s WHERE lower(trim(s.vibrasensitivity))='high' UNION ALL SELECT s.artref, 'PollutantSensitivity', s.pollutantsensitivity FROM sensitivitydata s WHERE lower(trim(s.pollutantsensitivity))='high' UNION ALL SELECT s.artref, 'PestSensitivity', s.pestsensitivity FROM sensitivitydata s WHERE lower(trim(s.pestsensitivity))='high' UNION ALL SELECT s.artref, 'HandleSensitivity', s.handlesensitivity FROM sensitivitydata s WHERE lower(trim(s.handlesensitivity))='high' UNION ALL SELECT s.artref, 'TransportSensitivity', s.transportsensitivity FROM sensitivitydata s WHERE lower(trim(s.transportsensitivity))='high' UNION ALL SELECT s.artref, 'DisplaySensitivity', s.displaysensitivity FROM sensitivitydata s WHERE lower(trim(s.displaysensitivity))='high' UNION ALL SELECT s.artref, 'StorageSensitivity', s.storagesensitivity FROM sensitivitydata s WHERE lower(trim(s.storagesensitivity))='high' ) t GROUP BY t.artref ), threshold AS ( SELECT MAX(7, 0) AS min_erf ) SELECT ec.artregistry, ec.artname, ROUND(ec.ERF,2) AS ERF, COALESCE(hs.high_sensitivities,'[]') AS high_sensitivities FROM erf_calc ec LEFT JOIN high_sens hs ON hs.artref = ec.artregistry, threshold th WHERE ec.ERF > th.min_erf ORDER BY ERF DESC LIMIT 100

query: Calculate and rank all artifacts by their Conservation Priority Index (CPI) to identify which need urgent attention. The report must include Artifact ID, name, its historical Dynasty and CPI Score.
sol_sql: WITH status_mapping AS ( SELECT ArtRegistry, ArtName, ArtDynasty, CASE ConserveStatus WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END AS status_score FROM ArtifactsCore ) SELECT a.ArtRegistry, a.ArtName, a.ArtDynasty, ( ( r.HistSignRating + r.ResearchValRating + r.CultScore ) * ( 10 - s.status_score ) ) / 30.0 AS CPI FROM status_mapping AS s JOIN ArtifactRatings AS r ON s.ArtRegistry = r.ArtRef JOIN ArtifactsCore AS a ON s.ArtRegistry = a.ArtRegistry ORDER BY CPI DESC NULLS FIRST

query: I want to see which historical periods have adequate conservation resources and which might be facing a Conservation Budget Crisis. For each dynasty, show the dynasty name, their total conservation priority index, the count of artifacts with adequate funding, the count with insufficient funding, the calculated CBE valuea, and a budget status that indicates 'Budget Crisis' if the dynasty meets the defined Conservation Budget Crisis criteria, and 'Within Budget' otherwise. Besides, please include a summary row for all dynasties combined labeled as 'ALL DYNASTIES'.
sol_sql: WITH artifact_cpi AS ( SELECT a.ArtRegistry, a.ArtName, a.ArtDynasty, ((r.HistSignRating + r.ResearchValRating + r.CultScore) * CASE a.ConserveStatus WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 9 WHEN 'Good' THEN 7 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 3 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 0 END) / 30.0 AS CPI FROM artifactscore a JOIN artifactratings r ON a.ArtRegistry = r.ArtRef ), budget_allocation AS ( SELECT ArtRefMaintained AS ArtRegistry, SUM(CASE WHEN BudgetAllocStatus = 'Adequate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS adequate_budget, SUM(CASE WHEN BudgetAllocStatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS insufficient_budget, COUNT(*) AS total_records FROM conservationandmaintenance GROUP BY ArtRefMaintained ) SELECT COALESCE(a.ArtDynasty, 'ALL DYNASTIES') AS dynasty, COUNT(a.ArtRegistry) AS artifact_count, SUM(c.CPI) AS total_cpi, SUM(b.adequate_budget) AS artifacts_with_adequate_budget, SUM(b.insufficient_budget) AS artifacts_with_insufficient_budget, SUM(c.CPI * (CAST(b.adequate_budget AS REAL) / IIF(b.total_records = 0, 1, b.total_records))) / IIF(COUNT(a.ArtRegistry) = 0, 1, COUNT(a.ArtRegistry)) AS CBE, CASE WHEN SUM(c.CPI * (CAST(b.adequate_budget AS REAL) / IIF(b.total_records = 0, 1, b.total_records))) / IIF(COUNT(a.ArtRegistry) = 0, 1, COUNT(a.ArtRegistry)) < 0.5 AND SUM(CASE WHEN a.ConserveStatus = 'Critical' AND b.insufficient_budget > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Budget Crisis' ELSE 'Within Budget' END AS budget_status FROM artifact_cpi c JOIN artifactscore a ON c.ArtRegistry = a.ArtRegistry LEFT JOIN budget_allocation b ON c.ArtRegistry = b.ArtRegistry GROUP BY a.ArtDynasty UNION ALL SELECT 'ALL DYNASTIES', COUNT(a.ArtRegistry), SUM(c.CPI), SUM(b.adequate_budget), SUM(b.insufficient_budget), SUM(c.CPI * (CAST(b.adequate_budget AS REAL) / IIF(b.total_records = 0, 1, b.total_records))) / IIF(COUNT(a.ArtRegistry) = 0, 1, COUNT(a.ArtRegistry)), CASE WHEN SUM(c.CPI * (CAST(b.adequate_budget AS REAL) / IIF(b.total_records = 0, 1, b.total_records))) / IIF(COUNT(a.ArtRegistry) = 0, 1, COUNT(a.ArtRegistry)) < 0.5 AND SUM(CASE WHEN a.ConserveStatus = 'Critical' AND b.insufficient_budget > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Budget Crisis' ELSE 'Within Budget' END FROM artifact_cpi c JOIN artifactscore a ON c.ArtRegistry = a.ArtRegistry LEFT JOIN budget_allocation b ON c.ArtRegistry = b.ArtRegistry;

query: Show me whether items are in Accelerated Deterioration, along with artifact's ID and name, the current temperature and humidity in their display case, how many high sensitivities they have, and whether they meet the accelerated deterioration criteria ('Yes' or 'No').
sol_sql: WITH MaterialDeterioration AS ( SELECT art.ArtRegistry, art.ArtName, sens.SensitivityRegistry, sens.EnvSensitivity, sens.LightSensitivity, sens.TempSensitivity, sens.HumiditySensitivity, sens.VibraSensitivity, sens.PollutantSensitivity, sens.PestSensitivity, ( CASE WHEN sens.EnvSensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN sens.LightSensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN sens.TempSensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN sens.HumiditySensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN sens.VibraSensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN sens.PollutantSensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN sens.PestSensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS high_sensitivity_count FROM artifactscore art JOIN sensitivitydata sens ON art.ArtRegistry = sens.ArtRef ), LatestReadings AS ( SELECT env.ShowcaseRef, env.TempC, env.RelHumidity, env.ReadTimestamp FROM environmentalreadingscore env WHERE env.EnvReadRegistry IN (SELECT MAX(EnvReadRegistry) FROM environmentalreadingscore GROUP BY ShowcaseRef) ), ArtifactMDR AS ( SELECT md.ArtRegistry, md.ArtName, md.high_sensitivity_count, ur.ShowcaseRefUsed, lr.TempC, lr.RelHumidity, (art.ArtAgeYears * CASE WHEN md.EnvSensitivity = 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN md.EnvSensitivity = 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN md.EnvSensitivity = 'High' THEN 10 END * POWER((lr.RelHumidity - 50), 2) * lr.TempC) / 100000.0 AS mdr FROM MaterialDeterioration md JOIN artifactscore art ON md.ArtRegistry = art.ArtRegistry JOIN usagerecords ur ON md.ArtRegistry = ur.ArtRefUsed LEFT JOIN LatestReadings lr ON ur.ShowcaseRefUsed = lr.ShowcaseRef ) SELECT mdr.ArtRegistry, mdr.ArtName, mdr.TempC AS current_temp, mdr.RelHumidity AS current_humidity, mdr.high_sensitivity_count, CASE WHEN mdr.mdr > 5 AND mdr.high_sensitivity_count >= 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS accelerated_deterioration FROM ArtifactMDR mdr;
